name: Cala Mitjana
description: A wide cove of pale sand and clear water, framed by cliffs that some use to leap into the sea. Near Cala Galdana, it pairs beauty with reasonable access.

practicalInfo.acceso: Easy walk (~15 min) from the car park through pine woods
practicalInfo.aparcamiento: A large free gravel car park at the entrance to Cala Galdana, capacity-controlled since 2025 (2026 season): a barrier closes it once full. In July and August it is best to be there before 10am. From the car park there is a signposted path of just over a kilometre, downhill. There is no point looking for a spot nearby: the lanes are narrow and parking on them is not allowed.
practicalInfo.servicios: No facilities: bring everything you need
practicalInfo.mejorEpoca: June and September. In August, early: in july and august, arrive between 7am and 7.30am. may, june and september give you far more room: in may the car parks do not fill up until 10 or 10.30am. Access control runs from 7.30am to 9pm and stays in place until 15 October.

planner.shuttleInfo: Large free dirt car park (~250 spaces) + 1.2 km signposted downhill path. Arrive before 10am in peak season. Bus L52 (Ciutadella) / L51 (Maó); also on foot from Cala Galdana along the Camí de Cavalls.
planner.effortNote: 1.2 km downhill path, mostly easy and family-friendly; not for wheelchairs.
highlights: walk the 1.2 km path from the car park down to the pale-sand cove
watch some leap into the water from the cliffs (with care)
arrive before 10 am in summer: the car park fills up early

imageAlt: The turquoise water of Cala Mitjana with its rock spit and the white cliff behind
